title: ModCheckerEnhanced
description: This plugin checks the mod folders of players upon joining the server. If any mods are found that are not on the whitelist, the player is automatically kicked.
body:
![Mod Checker Enhanced](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a5543a5461a8c706bab280ee626d4a6991e43eaf_0.webp)

⚠️ NOTE This plugin requires the mod dependency "Modsender" in order for the client to join the server. Please contact the creator if you need any help!

[Link to Modsender!](https://modrinth.com/mod/modsender)

## **Overview**
ModChecker scans players' mod folders upon joining and enforces a configurable whitelist. Players with unapproved mods are automatically kicked. The system also supports player exclusions, Bedrock auto-detection, and real-time configuration reloads.

## **Commands**
Aliases: mc, modcheck, mcheck

- /<command> check <player> - View a player's installed mods
- /<command> reload - Reload the configuration file
- /<command> whitelist <on|off> - Enable or disable the whitelist
- /<command> auto-exclude-bedrock <on|off> - Toggle automatic exclusion for Bedrock players
- /<command> mod add <mod> - Add a mod to the whitelist
- /<command> mod remove <mod> - Remove a mod from the whitelist
- /<command> mod list - List all whitelisted mods
- /<command> exclusion add <player> - Exempt a player from mod checks
- /<command> exclusion remove <player> - Remove a player from the exclusion list
- /<command> exclusion list - View all excluded players

## **Permissions**
modchecker.admin - Full access to all commands (Default: OP)

## **Requirements**
- Server: Paper 1.21.x
- Client: ModSender
- Java: 21+

## **Installation**
1. Place the JAR in your server's mods folder
2. Start the server to generate the configuration file
3. Configure your whitelist and settings
4. Reload with /<command> reload to apply changes

**ModChecker keeps your server secure and your mods under control.**
